Number Base Converter

Convert between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal with live syncing and per-base digit validation.

–
Bits
–
Decimal digits
–
Bytes

Non-negative integers only. Spaces and underscores are ignored. BigInt is used, so very large numbers convert exactly.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a number into any one of the four base fields.
  2. The other three bases update instantly as you type.
  3. Invalid digits for the chosen base show an error instead of converting.
  4. See the bit length, decimal digit count and byte size below.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why do I get an error when I type?

Each base only accepts its own digits: binary 0–1, octal 0–7, decimal 0–9, hexadecimal 0–9/A–F. Anything else is rejected with an error.

Does it handle very large numbers?

Yes. Conversion uses BigInt, so there is no 32-bit or floating-point limit — numbers with hundreds of digits convert exactly.

Can I convert negative or fractional numbers?

No. This tool supports non-negative integers only.
